item.title: Incumbents Sullivan Woods and Ulfelder defeat challenger Charney in Select Board race
item.description: Incumbent candidates Beth Sullivan Woods and Tom Ulfelder both won re-election for Wellesley’s chief governing body, the Select Board, in the March 3 Town-Wide election, according to unofficial election results. In an election with 3,659 ballots cast, Sullivan Woods secured votes on 72% of ballots, followed by Ulfelder with 54%. Marc Charney fell behind Ulfelder...

item.title: Org Spotlight: Committee for Political Engagement
item.description: The Committee for Political Engagement, known on campus as CPE, is a nonpartisan political club dedicated to open dialogue and encouraging political engagement. item.description: In a March 18 email to students and families, Wellesley announced a 4% increase in its comprehensive fee, raising it to $96,136 for the 2026-2027 academic year. item.title: One year later: WOAW and students march to commemorate the strike
item.description: On Friday, March 27, exactly a year after the Wellesley Organization of Academic Workers (WOAW) began its 29-day strike, the union of non-tenure-track (NTT) faculty led a march down Central Street to commemorate the strike. item.description: On March 24, Wellesley College hosted the Mabel Center for Immigrant Justice and Massachusetts Office for Refugees and Immigrants (ORI) for a “Know Your Rights” webinar providing immigration resources to students.
